## Delivery Budget

- Estimate confidence: medium

| ID | Work item | Effort | Architecture delta | Debt claim | Addresses | Rationale |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|---|---|
| W1 | Bind execution to approved plan provenance and inherited ledger | 5 | 2 | - | - | Adds a versioned durable approval reference and cross-run read boundary with compatibility tests. |
| W2 | Add phase-selected implementation protocol and pure classification rules | 3 | 1 | - | - | Threads a distinct public item/realization contract through schema, emitter and contextual validation. |
| W3 | Capture exact implementation review ranges and validate code hunks | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds persisted review context plus git evidence boundary; includes rename, restart and drift tests. |
| W4 | Compose and atomically record implementation reviews and telemetry | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds a versioned review observation using the existing finalizer, plus render/invoke/protocol parity. |
| W5 | Validate plan impacts and protect text-only amendment bytes | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds durable amendment guards and verification against committed plan structure and bytes. |
| W6 | Complete eligible corrections through fresh full quality evidence | 5 | 1 | - | - | Adds a commit/config-bound correction attempt and quality result contract; failure/retry tests included. |
| W7 | Reconcile approved debt claims and derive realized budget state | 5 | 1 | - | - | Extends inherited budget derivation and durable claim observations without a new effort ledger. |
| W8 | Extend typed gates, decision folds and rebuild for implementation | 5 | 1 | - | - | Extends shipped CAS and projections across domain/phase, including stale decision and successor tests. |
| W9 | Enforce phase admission/completion and final-run guards | 3 | 0 | - | - | Threads one boundary predicate through existing primitive/composite paths and bypass regressions. |
| W10 | Update implementation prompts and all delegation-mode skills | 3 | 0 | - | - | Multi-path workflow contracts, actionable-only authors, context injection and rendered asset tests. |
| W11 | Publish run-state telemetry, integrated acceptance and canonical docs | 3 | 0 | - | - | Exposes existing derived state and exercises full lifecycles; no new UI or workflow authority. |

Tests are included in each scored implementation item. Phase 0 is prerequisite verification, not scored product work. No debt credit is claimed for adding these governance concepts.

### Surface Snapshot

- Subsystems: 6
- Production files: 41
- Persistent/external boundaries: 2
- New shared abstractions: 4
- New persistent schemas: 1

Subsystems are protocol, command/workflow integration, review governance, budget arithmetic, record/index storage, and bundled assets. The persistent/external boundaries are the existing RecordStore stream format extensions and the existing Git/quality subprocess evidence boundary (no new external service). Production-file inventory is enumerated below; schema count is one additive migration with several rebuildable projections. New abstractions are the approved execution binding, code-review context, implementation observation, and correction-attempt evidence. Counts are audit expectations, not scores.

findings.title: Define when a separate execution run must bind to an approved plan
findings.failure: Operator starts a new execution run without review implementation bind; it silently takes the off/v1 path and bypasses all Phase 9 completion, reconciliation and gate guards.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: At the first implementation author admission, require a binding when the plan has a Delivery Budget and resolved mode is not off; auto-resolve a unique approved source run for the canonical plan via RecordStore, else return IMPLEMENTATION_APPROVAL_REQUIRED; add a bypass test.

findings.title: Capture pre-author HEAD as the initial phase diff base
findings.failure: Reviewed range omits part of the phase's code, so diff-causal validation rejects legitimate blockers in unreviewed commits and review misses defects.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Record the pre-delegation HEAD at the first same-phase author admission (template render/invoke) and use it as the base, verifying ancestry; for legacy history fall back to the parent of the earliest same-phase git:commit record, else the explicit context error.

findings.title: Reconcile approval-drift detection with guarded text-only amendments
findings.failure: After one legitimate text_only amendment, the plan hash no longer matches approval and the boundary denies phase completion or forces an unnecessary amendment workflow.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Measure drift against approved bytes plus the chain of guard-verified amendment commits (and checkbox-only changes); add a text-only-to-phase:complete lifecycle test.

findings.title: Specify claim-assessment carry-forward across the final-correction shortcut
findings.failure: In phases with due claims the shortcut either can never complete or bypasses reconciliation, depending on implementation order.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: State that the originating observation's assessments carry forward only through a CLI-recorded passing eligible correction attempt with zero architecture delta, empty boundary changes and a clean changed-path inventory; any other code change invalidates. Add a Phase 11 lifecycle case.

findings.title: Define the planImpact schema including text-only locations
findings.failure: The guard cannot determine which wording edits are authorized, so implementations either allow arbitrary non-table edits or reject all text-only passes.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Define planImpact as {kind: text_only|design|budget, locations:[{heading, staleText}]}; locations must be non-empty for text_only and each staleText must be unique under its heading at the approved commit; the guard allows byte changes only in those spans plus checkboxes; if missing or ambiguous, route to a human.

findings.title: Renumber the planned migration from v10 to v11
findings.failure: The implementer could try to reuse or renumber the shipped v10 migration, breaking upgrades of existing databases.
findings.lowestCostCorrection: Replace the v10 references with v11 / schema-v11.test.ts and list v10 among the verified dependency seams in Phase 0 and the Overview.

baselineAssessment.reason: Eleven work items reuse shipped 209 seams; W1 cross-run binding/rebuild, W3 git range edge cases and W8 domain-generalized CAS/acceptance plus migration each look about one point light versus the 47-point ledger.
